edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied USER-APPROVED single character portrait. Create its matching blank-face production base plate.
Output exactly the SAME 1024x1536 canvas. Retain exact positions, skull size, cheek and jaw outlines, ears, hairline, hair, headwear, neck, all clothing, armor, cloth details, hands, accessories, lighting, paper and fine ink/watercolor style. Only one face.
Erase BOTH eyebrows, BOTH eyes including eyelids and lashes, entire nose including nostril shadows, lips and mouth and the moustache immediately touching the lips. Replace these internal features with continuous natural skin matching cheeks. No ghost iris, eyelid, eyebrow, nostril or lip outlines. Keep chin beard and sideburns outside the internal feature zone if present. Do not add beard to clean-shaven people. This deliberately FEATURELESS face is a production base for separate genetic feature layers.
Precise local edit only. No pose change, resizing, movement, new expression, costume change, face outline change, color shift, new headwear, atlas grid change, border, watermark, labels or text. Keep whole crown and other existing details inside their exact canvas locations. Opaque pale paper, not transparent.
